channel.title: VESA Atelier Journal
channel.description: Reflections from VESA Atelier on calm, self-worth, and intentional living.

item.title: Why Do We Feel Guilty Even When We’ve Done Nothing Wrong?
item.description: On unnecessary guilt, people-pleasing, and learning to tell the difference between responsibility and the discomfort of setting a boundary.

item.title: What Does Self-Awareness Really Mean?
item.description: On self-awareness, emotional autopilot, and learning to meet yourself with curiosity instead of judgment.

item.title: Why Do Some People Fear Being Alone?
item.description: On solitude, silence, and learning to feel at peace in your own company without fear of what quiet might reveal.

item.title: Why Do We Keep Repeating the Same Mistakes?
item.description: On repeated patterns, emotional autopilot, and learning to break familiar cycles with awareness instead of shame.

item.title: Learning to Trust Yourself Again
item.description: On rebuilding self-trust, quiet promises, and learning to listen to your own voice again after doubt has taken hold.

item.title: Understanding Your Inner Critic
item.description: On the inner critic, self-compassion, and learning to respond to fear with curiosity instead of judgment.

item.title: Why Do We Compare Ourselves to Others?
item.description: On comparison, the illusion of highlight reels, and learning to measure growth against who you were yesterday.

item.title: Why Is It So Hard to Say No?
item.description: On the fear of saying no, the cost of always saying yes, and learning that healthy boundaries are an act of self-respect.

item.title: Why Do We Overthink Everything?
item.description: On overthinking, the search for certainty, and learning to notice your thoughts without being trapped by them.

item.title: The Hidden Reason We Keep Seeking Validation
item.description: On validation, the approval trap, and learning to offer yourself the kindness you freely give others.
